scope: Candidate-specific privacy/distribution delta review for owner-authorized public early-access guide tester; not visitor-standalone sharing or production release
inherited_scope: 31 unchanged V1 applications retain existing explicit guide-distribution authorization, including Library fields, internal Information Center procedures, Leadership and historical Naturalist material. No request to re-approve unchanged material.
new_content_scope: Owner-approved October Naturalist and Seahorse sections/media; prior explicit approval records remain byte-valid. No new patient records, IDs, account credentials or borrower data added by those updates.

snapshot.scope: Bounded static inventory and resource/API triage; manual review is recorded separately

manual_review.network: All five runtime fetch-containing files inspected. Hub/app-contract/developer/refresh fetch relative same-origin JSON. Worker handles only same-origin, in-scope GET requests and verifies prepared resources. No automatic offsite resource load remains in current static resource triage. No tracking SDK, remote script, iframe or upload/form endpoint found.
manual_review.browser_storage: Hub visit/search context uses sessionStorage; notice/cache preferences use localStorage. Developer intake, decisions and drafts use namespaced browser storage via local helpers. Developer module is excluded from tester artifacts. Review/export files are produced through user actions, not automatic server submission. Browser storage and exported files are not confidential storage or access control.
manual_review.links: External references, mail and phone links require user navigation/action. Destination services can receive normal request/referrer information when opened. Hosting receives normal web requests and may retain logs; no hosting log-policy change is asserted.
manual_review.distribution: Public early-access guide distribution matches existing owner authorization. No new authentication/private-vault promise is introduced. Confidential future visitor/traveler/patient data is outside this reviewed scope. New/materially altered content or distribution requires a new review.
manual_review.media: No pending catalog permission records; exact owner seahorse crop inspected for GPS EXIF tag, none present. Prior photo, illustration and source permissions retain their existing bounded decisions.
manual_review.qr_fix: Three automatic qrserver image requests replaced with one local PNG copied from the same fixed public-URL QR endpoint. QR destination and installation steps preserved. No third-party QR service required at page-view time. Independent physical camera scan remains part of device acceptance, not asserted here.

limitations: Static scanning is bounded triage, complemented by the named manual runtime review; it is not a guarantee against all possible browser/hosting behavior.
No new physical-device, pilot, rollback or production-release acceptance.
Future source/config/build-script changes invalidate the recorded snapshot and require privacy re-review; CI regression checks enforce the binding.

ci_reconciliation.cause: CI Python checks generate scripts/**/__pycache__/*.pyc before npm test; these were wrongly counted as source inputs.
ci_reconciliation.change: Exclude only generated Python .pyc files under scripts/**/__pycache__; actual source/config/build files remain hashed and symlinks remain rejected.
